notes.title: Patch: 1.02a
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support! Over the past days, we've been hard at work fixing bugs and polishing things up, and this wouldn't be possible if not for your incredible consideration of reporting these issues to us. I wanted to thank everyone who's been playing the game, and we hope this should iron out most things that we've been collecting feedback on as of lately! If there's anything else we should focus on, please let us know!

- Fixed replays not using the correct skill selected when playing it originally

- Fixed new input key addition text size

- Updated translations for all languages

- Fixed character names from act 9 not showing up appropriately in japanese

- Fixed stage backgrounds not showing appropriately in act 12 and staff roll

- Balance changes:

- - Skills:

- - - Tutorial skill: increased radius from 50 to 65

- - - Act 1 client skill: increased duration from 8 frames to 20 frames

- - - Act 2 client skill: increased bonus from 50% to 60%

- - - Act 4 client skill: increased bonus from 50% to 100%

- - - Act 5 client skill: increased charge from 50% to 70%

- - - Act 6 client skill: removed usage limit, decreased clear radius from 50 to 15

- - - Act 7 client skill: increased rate from 15% to 20%

- - - Act 8 client skill: increased duration from 2 seconds to 5 seconds

- - - Act 10 client skill: reduced charge requirement of 100% to 60%, increased duration from 15 frames to 30 frames, reduced charge penalty from 0 to 50

- - Bosses:

- - - Act 2-3: Reduced overall bullet count

- - - Act 4-4: Reduced photo count from 7 to 6, reduced enemy count

- - - Act 4-5: Reduced photo count from 8 to 7

- - - Act 5-4: Reduced photo count from 7 to 6

- - - Act 7-8: Reduced photo count from 5 to 4

- - - Act 8-1: Reduced photo count from 9 to 8

- - - Act 8-3: Reduced photo count from 5 to 4

- - - Act 8-7: Reduced photo count from 5 to 4

- - - Act 9-1: Reduced photo count from 7 to 6

- - - Act 9-2: Reduced bubble circle radius, reduced bubble count

- - - Act 9-3: Longer interval between bubbles, reduced bubble size, longer interval between enemies, reduced photo count from 7 to 6

- - - Act 9-4: Reduced photo count from 8 to 7

- - - Act 9-5: Longer interval between knives, increased crystal bullet count, reduced crystal bullet speed

- - - Act 9-7: Reduced photo count from 5 to 4

- - - Act 9-9: Reduced heart bullet count

- - - Act 9-11: Reduced orange bullets center chance, reduced red bullets count

- - - Act 10-1: Reduced photo count from 6 to 5

- - - Act 10-2: Reduced photo count from 7 to 6

- - - Act 10-5: Reduced photo count from 8 to 7
